runner: research/runners/stable_recal_calibration_record.py (reads the cited artifacts; the rules are typed judgments)
what: thought-swap workspace (research/runners/_gnw_neural_swap_intention_derisk.py) re-calibrated by its own rules on the stable integrator (SIM_STABLE_INTEGRATION=1); every value chosen on the isolated organ on dev seeds 7 and 8, never on a reply

seed_roles.reading: dev seeds 7 and 8 are the CALIBRATION seeds of the swap workspace (bus: seed 7), so any OFF-versus-RECAL comparison on them (the whole-brain dev check, reply identity, answer rate) is IN-SAMPLE. Held-out dev seeds are the other organ-gate seeds (1-6, 9-15) for the isolated organ; no whole-brain comparison on a held-out seed has been run (the pool battery of dev seeds 1-12 is written, not queued)

integrator_finding: on the old integrator at the production constants the workspace ignition knee (2000 -> 2500 pA, seed 7) is the drive at which 112-118 of 300 workspace cells leave the valid membrane range and the 1/3 ignited rate is that runaway; on the stable integrator weight 34 with thal 700 is depolarization block / spontaneous all-pattern activation and no weight 5-60 or normalization 0-64 gives a selective sustained ignition

w_rec.rule: at nws 4 the sustain knee lies between 4.0 (0.28-0.38 of read windows below half the plateau) and 4.5 (none; plateau 0.067-0.068); the production weight is deliberately supra-critical (the incumbent resists inhibition), so 6.5 (about 1.4x the knee; plateau 0.084, worst window 0.069-0.076) was chosen: a judgment, not a formula; the organ gate passes at it

norm_ws_w.rule: largest norm_pool->workspace weight whose sustained state reads reliably in the organ's 15-step read window (read15: fraction of windows below half the plateau, steps 100-1000, thal 0, drive 2500, stable): at nws 16 and 8 every weight 4-6.5 has 0.53-0.93 of windows below half; at 6 still 0.23-0.42; at 5 none below half for w >= 5 but the worst window is only ~0.55 of the plateau (0.041-0.045 vs 0.074); at 4 none below half for w >= 4.5 and the worst window is 0.82-0.90 of the plateau. 4 was chosen over 5 for that margin (a judgment, recorded as such)

thal_tonic_pa.rule: largest thalamic support with no spontaneous ignition over 1000 undriven steps on both seeds (w 6.5, nws 4): 25 pA leaves every pattern at 0.0 on seeds 7 and 8; at 50 pA seed 7 ignites pattern 0 by itself between steps 600 and 1000 (0.029 then 0.084), at 75 pA seed 8 ignites pattern 1 by itself; at 200 and 700 pA all three patterns fire together (0.05-0.06).

solo_plateau.rule: the measured ignited plateau at (6.5, 4, 25) on the stable integrator; the ignition criterion stays IGNITE_FRAC (0.5) x plateau = 0.042, scoped to the swap organ (the global-stop workspace shares Rung-2's SOLO_PLATEAU and is not re-calibrated here)

establish_pa.rule: the production ratio of establishment drive to ignition knee (8000 / 2500 = 3.2) applied to the stable knee (300 pA sub, 400 pA ignites): 3.2 x 400

w_ws_occ.rule: FORMULA, checked by a sweep: conserve the occupancy read's input (weight x plateau): 8 x (1/3) / 0.084 = 31.7; the w_ws_occ sweep 8, 16, 32, 64 keeps the gate and mismatch primitives holding on both seeds (the veto strengthens with the weight)

w_pat_pred.rule: the same conservation as w_ws_occ applied to the held-content prediction read (8 x (1/3) / 0.084 = 31.7, rounded to 32). No cited artifact varies w_pat_pred; the organ GO gate and the mismatch sweeps were run with it at 32, which shows they pass with it there, not that 32 is better than another value

w_occ_gate.rule: the vacancy veto knee: occupied-gate rate 0.215/0.199 at 20 (no veto), 0.093/0.077 at 40, 0.044/0.037 at 80 (empty gate ~0.19); 80 is where the veto saturates; no inversion up to 160 on the stable integrator

evidence.reading: the vacancy-gate primitive holds at w_gate_ws 1, 2, 4, 8 on both seeds and fails at 16 (seed 7), 32 (seed 8) and 100; the FULL ORGAN was run at 1 and 4 only: at 1 the swap fails on seed 7 (the newcomer never ignites, rate 0.037) and passes on seed 8, at 4 both seeds swap. 2 and 8 were not run through the organ; 4 is the middle of the primitive's admissible 2-8 band, not a measured optimum

w_gate_ws.rule: the gate primitive (empty admits, held vetoes, self survives) holds for 1-8 on both seeds and fails at 16 (s7) / 32 (s8) and at the production 100; in the full organ w_gate_ws=1 fails the swap on seed 7 (newcomer 0.037; swap_organ_gate_wgate1/) and 4 passes it; 4 is the middle of the primitive's admissible 2-8 band (2 and 8 were not run through the organ)

timing_window.rule: the organ's stated rule is 3 ignition periods (TIMING_WINDOW comment in _gnw_neural_swap_intention_derisk.py); an ignited neuron spikes every 3 steps on the old integrator (9 = 3 spikes) and every 1/0.084 = 11.9 steps on the stable one (3 spikes = 36); a read-only timing instrument, not used by production replies. ORDER: the window was left at the production 9 first (GO 4 of 15, every failure the timing check) and was re-derived to 36 by this rule AFTER that result; see order_of_events

unchanged.rule: the mismatch detector reads 0.154 (salient) / 0.035-0.038 (non-salient) on stable, so the salient boost reaches the 0.16 cap and the non-salient boost stays ~0.06; the eviction collapse knee on stable is 0.06-0.10 (held <= 0.05 s7, <= 0.08 s8; non-monotone above)

production_stable_integrator_s7_s8.note: nothing reaches the production ignition criterion
